subject: Capacity swap + credit bridge — OrbitAI Dedicated proposal
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@orbitai.com>
Cc: Paul Young <paul@orbitai.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity swap + credit bridge — OrbitAI Dedicated proposal

Laura / Paul —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation I attached a pared-down Term Sheet showing:
- a 12-month reserved GPU pool (8x A100-equivalent slots) sized for your 95th percentile bursts,
- a 10% throughput SLA uplift during peak windows, and
- an onboarding credit bridge to offset migration cost in months 1–3.

High-level ask from my side: if OrbitAI can commit to the 12-month reserved pool and a single-region deployment (us-west), we can extend a one-time migration credit of $120k (applied as three monthly invoice credits) plus an additional 5% discount on the first-year unit price.

I called this a "credit bridge" to keep us flexible on final invoice structure while giving OrbitAI runway to ramp. Two quick open points I want to confirm with you so I can loop in Finance:
1) Do you need a firm commit to the 12-month term or is a 9-month ramp acceptable?
2) Procurement mentioned they may require a consolidated PO that matches invoice timing — will you be submitting an initial PO or do we sign first and they process after?

Attachments: OrbitAI_Dedicated_TermSheet_v3.pdf (term sheet), SOW-OrbitAI-draft.docx (onboarding statement of work).

Happy to hop on a short call tomorrow to walk through line items.

Best,

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

---

From: Laura Chen <laura@orbitai.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Young <paul@orbitai.com>, procure@orbitai.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity swap + credit bridge — OrbitAI Dedicated proposal

Alex —

Thanks for putting this together and for the call. The term sheet looks close. A few notes from our side after a quick procurement review:
- OrbitAI prefers a 9-month ramp + 3-month optional extension (we want flexibility because of model training seasonality).
- Procurement will require a single PO that covers month 1–3 credits in one remittance (they prefer credits reflected on month 1 invoice).
- Competitive situation: VertexPartners offered a 15% first-year discount + a $150k migration credit if we sign by 4/20. We like Redwood's runtime and observability but that delta matters to execs.

Can your team match closer to a $150k credit (or move the 5% to a 10% first-year discount) in exchange for committing to the 12-month reserved pool? If you need to escalate for an exception, loop in whoever you need — we have our execs waiting for a final commercial.

Thanks —
Laura
Head of Product Partnerships, OrbitAI
laura@orbitai.com | +1 (206) 555-2444

---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@orbitai.com>, Paul Young <paul@orbitai.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Capacity swap + credit bridge — OrbitAI Dedicated proposal

Marissa / Rishi —

Forwarding OrbitAI's counter (below). They have a competing offer: $150k migration credit + 15% first-year discount if they sign by 4/20. Client prefers a 9-month ramp + 3-month optional extension but says they're willing to commit to 12 months if we can get closer to the $150k credit or increase discount to 10%.

Quick ask: can we approve a $150k one-time migration credit (applied as invoice credits) for strategic value here? OrbitAI is early-stage but strategic — deep integrations planned, potential dedicated expansion in EU in H2. If not, what's the max credit/discount we can offer without an exec signoff?

Notes for context:
- Current pricing guidance: standard migration credit allowance is $80k for this SKU band; larger credits require VP sales signoff.
- We should consider trade-offs: shorten onboarding scope (reduce some professional services) in exchange for higher credit, or require a firm 12-month commit to get full credit.

Happy to jump on a 15-min sync.

Thanks,
Alex

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@orbitai.com>, Paul Young <paul@orbitai.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Capacity swap + credit bridge — OrbitAI Dedicated proposal

Alex —

Thanks for the context. I'm supportive of a concession but want to ensure we protect unit economics. My initial greenlight parameters:
- Approve up to $120k migration credit at SDR level without exec signoff, provided OrbitAI signs a 12-month firm commit and pays month 1 upfront.
- For anything above $120k (or >7% first-year discount), we need VP Sales approval (I can escalate) and a one-pager showing strategic value (expansion path, references, potential ARR in 12 months).

Suggested counter to OrbitAI: 1) commit to a 12-month term with month 1 upfront payment, and we'll provide $120k migration credit + 7% first-year discount; 2) if OrbitAI can provide a signed LOI by 4/18 and a customer reference call, we can escalate to consider the $150k credit + 10% discount for exec approval.

I'll draft a short executive memo if needed. Rishi — please flag any finance or SLA concerns.

-Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Capacity swap + credit bridge — OrbitAI Dedicated proposal

Team / Laura —

Quick finance note after reviewing the numbers: we can stretch to a $140k one-time migration credit if OrbitAI signs the 12-month reserved pool AND prepays month 1 upfront (credit applied over three invoices). The additional delta (to $150k) would require VP-level signoff and we should get a short strategic memo showing EU expansion potential (to justify fungibility of capacity and marketing reference).

Rishi Malhotra
